title: The Cantor–Schroeder–Bernstein statement reverses the second injection domain.
details: Cenzer–Remmel2017, Theorem1.9.7 p22, states injections f:A→B and g:A→B and concludes an isomorphism A→B. The second injection must be g:B→A. As printed, a singleton A and a two-element B satisfy the two injection hypotheses but admit no bijection. The surrounding Myhill discussion has the intended opposite-direction reductions. This adjacent statement is not newly adopted.
